status: MAT assembly and envelope proof of the actual HAD successor; no technical/material acceptance

boundaries.floor: Permanent occupied floor; no removable room cover, custom gas lid or liner-supported floor
boundaries.air_gas: Concrete/mineral junction is a provisional boundary only; cracking, joints and site gas remain unqualified. No zero-thickness metal membrane is silently added.
boundaries.liner: One joint-free underbridge open U body, supported on a removable backing carriage; complete rails, anti-galling contact, keepers and restraints remain design duties
boundaries.renewal: Selected direction, platform, track and park come from HAD. Entire body/carriage follows the bed gradient; final hoist must clear actual fixed support faces, not only wall faces.
boundaries.ground: Route-local clearance lower bound only. Actual bridge seats/nodes and whole-house foundation network can control a deeper solum. No groundwater tanking, pump or actual site grade is assumed.
boundaries.water: No event, inlet, debris, pressure, free-transfer capture, receiving-head or first-harm acceptance. An open U rim is not a qualified emergency operating water level.
